name: Lazarus RipDoc Augmentation Surgical Full Rig
description:
A complete street-clinic augmentation surgeon's kit: antimicrobial slate-teal scrub top and drawstring trousers in fluid-resistant BioWeave, a knee-length sterile apron with magnetic tool-strip across the chest, nitrile-grip gloves with haptic feedback pads at the fingertips, and low-profile closed-toe clogs with puncture-resistant soles. A lightweight magnifying visor flips up from a padded headband, and a rear neck pocket holds a sterile BCI tap tool.

The apron's chest strip holds scalpels, neural probes, and chrome calibration wands via magnet. Everything is bleach-rated and designed for fast decontam between patients.
functionality: Fluid-repellent BioWeave resists blood and coolant splash, magnetic tool-strip for surgical instrument retention, haptic fingertip pads for precision chrome calibration, flip-up magnifying visor for neural port work, BCI tap tool pocket.
what_it_says: They fix what hospitals won't touch, for people hospitals won't see.
story_hooks: The apron's magnetic strip has a custom slot for a piece of military-grade chrome that isn't sold commercially — and the doc won't say where they got it.
The haptic gloves are logged to a stolen BCI calibration license, meaning every surgery technically belongs to a Tier 4 hospital upspire.
A patient's chrome arm left trace coolant on the apron that matches a rare military-grade fluid — someone powerful came through this clinic recently.

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian surgical ensemble that reads as street-clinic pragmatism—slate-teal scrubs with clinical geometry, layered with a knee-length sterile apron that transforms the wearer into a mobile augmentation workstation. The silhouette is functional and compressed, suggesting serious work and minimal wasted motion.
physical_description.fit: Tailored-relaxed throughout; scrubs have a slight taper at the wrists and ankles for seal integrity, drawstring trousers sit at natural waist, apron drapes with structured panels to distribute tool weight evenly across the torso.
physical_description.primary_material: BioWeave fluid-resistant synth-polymer base (scrubs and apron), nitrile-grip composite (gloves), reinforced canvas-weave apron with magnetic contact strips, elastomer-soled clogs with puncture-resistant ballistic layer.
physical_description.texture: Scrubs have a soft micro-matte finish; apron fabric is slightly stiff and noise-dampening, designed to shed fluids without pooling. Gloves have textured grip pads on palms and haptic-sensitive fingertips. Clogs have a rubberized non-slip tread.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary slate-teal with charcoal grey reinforced panels on apron shoulders and lower hem. Chrome tool-strip accent across chest glints under surgical lighting. White trim at wrist and ankle cuffs for contamination visibility.
physical_description.closures: Scrub top: concealed snap buttons down left side. Trousers: drawstring with locking toggle. Apron: magnetic latch neck piece, side velcro straps. Gloves: friction-fit pull-on with wrist band. Visor: friction-lock to padded headband.
distinctive_features: Chest-mounted magnetic tool-strip holding scalpels, neural probes, chrome calibration wands
Flip-up magnifying visor with integrated headband padding
Rear neck pocket sized specifically for sterile BCI tap tool
Haptic feedback pads at fingertip of gloves for precision neural work
Bleach-rated seams throughout for rapid decontamination
Puncture-resistant sole on clogs—standard against dropped sharp instruments
Fluid-resistant BioWeave treated to shed biofluid without absorbance
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 working class, elevated by specialization—marks the wearer as licensed street-clinic talent with access to quality synth materials, but clearly operational rather than corporate-polished.
physical_description.cultural_context: Street augmentation surgeon or mobile RipDoc operative. Signals medical competence, illegal-or-gray autonomy, and deep familiarity with the GLMZ's underground prosthetic economy. Wearing this announces: 'I will put chrome in your spine in a back-alley clinic and make it *stick*.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained but bearing visible traces of work—faint stains on apron hem (always cleaned but never gone), micro-scratches on tool-strip from constant magnetic attachment/release, gloves replaced frequently (usually shows fresh pair), visor lens occasionally fogged from exertion.
